reviews.author: Vikram Yoganand
reviews.title: Excellent Smart Door Lock with Outstanding Battery Life
reviews.body: I have been using this smart door lock for nearly 2 years, and I am very happy with its performance. The battery life is too good and lasts much longer than expected, making it very convenient for daily use. The lock offers multiple unlocking options, and the fingerprint recognition is fast and accurate. The build quality feels premium, and the security features give peace of mind. Another thing I appreciate is that the customer support is also good for any queries. reviews.author: Surya P.
reviews.title: Good Smart Lock
reviews.body: Good but lock/unlock cannot be done from the smartlife app. We get option to unlock only when bell is pressed. You cannot check lock status, you cannot trigger lock from app if you forget to set auto-lock and forgot to lock as well. You cannot add this device to Google Home unless you do some research on it. Fun fact their CS even don't know how to connect to Google Home. No Indian language support even though the brand calls itself Indian, instead we get Chinese as second language for the settings.
